item_name: Behavioral Symptom—Presence & Frequency: Verbal behavioral symptoms directed toward others

lookback_source.quote: Review the medical record for the 7-day look-back period.

lookback_notes: The item's own pages state a 7-day look-back period for E0200 (Steps for Assessment, p. E-5) and the coding instructions repeatedly reference "the last 7 days." Counted per the general convention as the ARD plus the 6 previous calendar days (rai-manual-v1.20.1, p. 2-17: "ARD + 6 previous calendar days"). The section intent statement also frames these as "behavioral symptoms in the last seven days" (p. E-1). No other time windows are stated for this item.

coding_levels.label: Behavior not exhibited
coding_levels.definition: The behavioral symptoms were not present in the last 7 days. Use this code if the symptom has never been exhibited or if it previously has been exhibited but has been absent in the last 7 days.

source.quote: Code 0, behavior not exhibited: if the behavioral symptoms were not present in the last 7 days. Use this code if the symptom has never been exhibited or if it previously has been exhibited but has been absent in the last 7 days.

coding_levels.label: Behavior of this type occurred 1-3 days
coding_levels.definition: The behavior was exhibited 1-3 days of the last 7 days, regardless of the number or severity of episodes that occur on any one of those days.

source.quote: Code 1, behavior of this type occurred 1-3 days: if the behavior was exhibited 1-3 days of the last 7 days, regardless of the number or severity of episodes that occur on any one of those days.

coding_levels.label: Behavior of this type occurred 4-6 days, but less than daily
coding_levels.definition: The behavior was exhibited 4-6 of the last 7 days, regardless of the number or severity of episodes that occur on any of those days.

source.quote: Code 2, behavior of this type occurred 4-6 days, but less than daily: if the behavior was exhibited 4-6 of the last 7 days, regardless of the number or severity of episodes that occur on any of those days.

coding_levels.label: Behavior of this type occurred daily
coding_levels.definition: The behavior was exhibited daily, regardless of the number or severity of episodes that occur on any of those days.

source.quote: Code 3, behavior of this type occurred daily: if the behavior was exhibited daily, regardless of the number or severity of episodes that occur on any of those days.

federal_coding_rules.rule: E0200B captures verbal behavioral symptoms directed toward others (e.g., threatening others, screaming at others, cursing at others); enter a code in the box.

source.quote: B. Verbal behavioral symptoms directed toward others (e.g., threatening others, screaming at others, cursing at others)

federal_coding_rules.rule: Code based on whether the symptoms occurred, not on an interpretation of the behavior's meaning or cause or the assessor's judgment that the behavior can be explained or should be tolerated.

source.quote: Code based on whether the symptoms occurred and not based on an interpretation of the behavior's meaning, cause or the assessor's judgment that the behavior can be explained or should be tolerated.

federal_coding_rules.rule: Code as present even if staff have become used to the behavior or view it as typical or tolerable.

source.quote: Code as present, even if staff have become used to the behavior or view it as typical or tolerable.

federal_coding_rules.rule: Behaviors in these categories are coded as present or not present whether or not they might represent a rejection of care.

source.quote: Behaviors in these categories should be coded as present or not present, whether or not they might represent a rejection of care.

federal_coding_rules.rule: Resident intent must not be taken into account when coding items in Section E; the section focuses on the resident's actions, not the intent of the behavior.

source.quote: Resident intent should not be taken into account when coding for items in this section.

federal_coding_rules.rule: The coding of E0200B feeds item E0300: if E0200A, E0200B, and E0200C are all coded 0, E0300 is coded 0 (no) and the assessor skips to E0800; if any of E0200A, E0200B, or E0200C is coded 1, 2, or 3, E0300 is coded 1 (yes) and E0500 and E0600 are completed.

source.quote: Code 1, yes: if any of E0200A, E0200B, or E0200C were coded 1, 2, or 3. Proceed to complete Impact on Resident item (E0500), and Impact on Others item (E0600).

federal_coding_rules.rule: All behavioral symptoms coded in E0200 (including E0200B) are the basis for coding the impact items E0500A–C and E0600A–C.

source.quote: Code E0500A, E0500B, and E0500C based on all of the behavioral symptoms coded in E0200.

federal.criterion: Review of the resident's medical record covering the 7-day look-back period.

source.quote: Review the medical record for the 7-day look-back period.

federal.notes: Listed as step 1 of Steps for Assessment for E0200.

federal.criterion: Interviews with staff across all shifts and disciplines, and with others who had close interactions with the resident during the 7-day look-back period, including family or friends who visit frequently or have frequent contact with the resident.

source.quote: Interview staff, across all shifts and disciplines, as well as others who had close interactions with the resident during the 7-day look-back period, including family or friends who visit frequently or have frequent contact with the resident.

federal.notes: Step 2 of Steps for Assessment for E0200.

federal.criterion: Direct observation of the resident in a variety of situations during the 7-day look-back period.

source.quote: Observe the resident in a variety of situations during the 7-day look-back period.

federal.notes: Step 3 of Steps for Assessment for E0200.

federal.criterion: Documentation supports comparison to a baseline on subsequent assessments to identify changes in the resident's behavior, including response to interventions.

source.quote: Subsequent assessments and documentation can be compared to baseline to identify changes in the resident's behavior, including response to interventions.

federal.notes: Framed as rationale/planning for care rather than a required documentation element.

case_mix_relevance.notes: The supplied pages do not tie E0200B to any payment or case-mix classification.
